description: This file implements a preference store for Mattermost, handling CRUD operations for user preferences in a SQL database, including batch deletions and cleanup of orphaned data.

classes.name: SqlPreferenceStore
classes.description: Struct implementing preference storage with methods for CRUD operations and cleanup tasks.

methods.name: newSqlPreferenceStore
methods.description: Initializes a new SqlPreferenceStore with a base query builder.

methods.name: deleteUnusedFeatures
methods.description: Deletes preferences related to unused feature toggles.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves multiple preferences within a transaction, ensuring atomicity.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Helper method to insert or update a single preference within a transaction.

methods.name: saveTx
methods.description: Helper method to insert or update a preference within a transaction.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific preference by user ID, category, and name.

methods.name: GetCategoryAndName
methods.description: Retrieves preferences matching a specific category and name.

methods.name: GetCategory
methods.description: Retrieves preferences for a specific user and category.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all preferences for a specific user.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteByUser
methods.description: Deletes all preferences for a specific user.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific preference by user ID, category, and name.

methods.name: DeleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes preferences for a specific user and category.

methods.name: DeleteCategoryAndName
methods.description: Deletes preferences matching a specific category and name.

methods.name: DeleteOrphanedRows
methods.description: Removes preferences that no longer have corresponding posts.

methods.name: CleanupFlagsBatch
methods.description: Deletes flagged preferences with no associated posts, limited by a batch size.

methods.name: DeleteInvalidVisibleDmsGms
methods.description: Deletes preferences for DMs/GMs where the value is outside valid bounds.
